search_window.basis: Verified previous Food Line watch-ledger heartbeat completion. Searches use 2-day recency to detect newly indexed reporting; only new or materially changed qualifying disruptions in this interval are findings.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary audited-miss recall only; production nationwide Food Line collector is authoritative.
target_classes: Loss, closure, fire or disaster affecting a community's only, sole, last or full-service grocery store
Canceled or suspended emergency food distribution due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure or major food-access reduction
Official new SNAP, WIC or food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
search_queries: "only grocery store" fire closure flooded November 9 2026
"last grocery store" closes November 2026 rural town
"only full service grocery store" closed November 2026 storm
"food bank" "closed due to" fire storm flood November 9 2026

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Georgia Public Broadcasting's November 6 report documents loss of McCaysville's only grocery store following flooding; already recorded in prior watches and no verified materially new impact since 01:51:11 PST.
November 9 Mobile Food Pantry distributions remain scheduled, not canceled; routine listings excluded.
Arizona AHCCCS November 8 system upgrade was preannounced on October 26 and affects the AHCCCS Solutions Center, not newly verified SNAP/WIC benefit access.
Standing application/telephone wait-time notice, without a new dated immediate benefits interruption.
November 9, 2025 SNAP legal dispute, not November 2026; date-confounded search hit.
Only grocery store fire occurred March 2020, out of window.

source_or_search_failures.note: Recurring USDA SNAP state-directory access restriction. Other state agency pages and targeted searches accessible. Does not establish current disruption.

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: Twelve targeted searches returned results without tool errors; results were mostly older grocery closures, legacy 2025 SNAP reports, routine pantry listings or unrelated agency documents. Seven of eight direct sources accessible. No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption verified in the bounded hourly interval; limited source discovery cannot establish absence nationwide. One nonmaterial USDA 403 yields DEGRADED rather than SUCCESS.
coverage_notes.excluded_content: Donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine program promotion, inflation commentary, historical events, undated references, duplicates and non-food-agency interruptions.
coverage_notes.notification_assessment: No new qualifying signal and only a recurring nonmaterial source-access restriction; user notification suppressed.
coverage_notes.controls: No review approvals, publication, production changes, schedule modifications, task disabling or other mutations.
